postcard.title: Looking up
postcard.note: Julia and Daniel looking at the Parthenon. We forgot our togas.
postcard.caption: Julia and Daniel looking at the Parthenon. We forgot our togas. Twenty-four centuries, and it still does the looking-up.

word.meaning: Toga — the ancient Greek word for the Roman wrap. We forgot ours at the Parthenon.
